# g24 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 2
- **Domain**: 0 ≤ x_1 ≤ 3, 0 ≤ x_2 ≤ 4

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = - x_1 - x_2
```

### Constraints
```math
g_1(x) = -2 x_1^4 + 8 x_1^3 - 8 x_1^2 + x_2 - 2 \leq 0
```
```math
g_2(x) = -4 x_1^4 + 32 x_1^3 - 88 x_1^2 + 96 x_1 + x_2 - 36 \leq 0
```

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = -5.508013
